sources.title: t5-base-japanese: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview t5-base-japanese is a Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer model pretrained on approximately 100GB of Japanese text by sonoisa. The model contains 222 million parameters and was trained on Japanese Wikipedia (July 2020 dump), OSCAR Japanese corpus, and CC-100 Japanese data using SentencePiece tokenization. Built with the transformers library, this model is a base-sized T5 variant ...
